description: Submitting a DIFFERENT result payload for an attempt that already has an accepted result must be rejected as a conflict, not silently accepted and not silently discarded.
notes: Implemented by issue #11: VersusSeries.CompleteAttempt now compares the incoming result to the already-accepted one before returning early - an equal payload takes fixture 10's idempotent-success path; a different payload throws ConflictingAttemptResultException (mapped to HTTP 409), leaving the originally accepted result untouched. Unity's Attempt.Complete does not special-case 'was the resubmission identical' - it always throws - so this remains a protocol-level (transport-retry) distinction the Backend alone needs, per issue #8 section 13.
